newsitem.title: UK: Vosper shares gain after Qatar deal.
newsitem.headline: Vosper shares gain after Qatar deal.

text.p: Shares in warship builder Vosper Thorneycroft Plc rose on Monday after the weekend signing of a $825 million defence agreement between the UK and Qatar including the supply of 46-metre patrol boats.
The stock was up 35p at 870 by 1047 GMT in thin volume of 48,619 shares.

Vosper later said in a statement the memorandum of understanding (MOU), signed on Sunday, included the provision of two 46-metre patrol craft produced by the company, which represented a fifth of the total value of the contract.
"This is tremendous news for Vosper Thornycroft and shows that the UK can achieve when we all work together," said Martin Jay, Vosper's managing director, in the statement.
The statement said the MOU covered the provision of a major package of British defence equipment valued at 500 million stg and also involving GKN, British Aerospace and Shorts Missile Systems.
